name: New year clock
summary: Big round clock face just before midnight, hands near twelve with confetti around it. Anim tick moves the hands to 12.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the clock face

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the clock is about 520 px across with confetti about 1000 px

params.name: anim
params.note: tick = the minute hand moves up to 12 over about 1.3 s and stays there; frame 0 is just before midnight

author: krakujs
